design_overview: A modern, elegant flower delivery app designed with a focus on visual appeal, ease of browsing, and seamless checkout. The design emphasizes high-quality product imagery, clear navigation, and intuitive user flows. The color palette is inspired by nature with soft florals and earthy tones, creating a welcoming and trustworthy shopping experience. The UI prioritizes touch-friendly interactions, clear visual hierarchy, and realistic app-like behavior suitable for both iOS and Android platforms.

screens.name: Home Screen
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showcasing featured flowers, categories, and promotions to encourage browsing and discovery

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo on left and notification bell icon on right, height 60px, padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to notifications screen

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray background (#F0F0F0), rounded corners (12px), placeholder text 'Search flowers...', left-aligned search icon, height 48px, margin 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with keyboard and filter options

key_components.name: Hero Banner
key_components.styling: Full-width image card with gradient overlay, rounded corners (16px), height 200px, contains heading 'Spring Collection' and 'Shop Now' button, margin 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to featured collection screen

key_components.name: Category Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Browse by Category', 20px font size, left-aligned, margin 24px top, 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive label

key_components.name: Category Horizontal Scroll
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list of category cards, each card 120px wide with rounded image (80px), category name below, spacing 12px between cards
key_components.interaction: Tapping a category card navigates to category-specific flower listing

key_components.name: Popular Flowers Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Popular Flowers', 20px font size, left-aligned with 'View All' link on right, margin 24px top, 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: View All link navigates to full catalog

key_components.name: Popular Flowers Grid
key_components.styling: 2-column grid of flower product cards, each card has square image (160px), flower name, price, and heart icon for favorites, white background, rounded corners (12px), shadow, spacing 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to flower detail screen, heart icon toggles favorite status

key_components.name: Special Offer Banner
key_components.styling: Full-width promotional card with light accent background, rounded corners (12px), contains discount text '20% Off First Order', height 100px, margin 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to promotional offers screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar with 5 icons (Home, Search, Cart, Orders, Profile), white background, height 64px, icons with labels, active state in primary color
key_components.interaction: Each icon navigates to respective screen

screens.user_flow: Entry point of the app after login. Users can browse categories, view popular flowers, search, or navigate to other sections via bottom navigation. Tapping any flower card leads to detail screen.

screens.name: Flower Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Display comprehensive information about a selected flower including images, description, pricing, and add-to-cart functionality

key_components.name: Top Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Transparent overlay on image with back arrow on left and share icon on right, height 56px, icons in white with subtle shadow
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, share icon opens share sheet

key_components.name: Product Image Gallery
key_components.styling: Full-width swipeable image carousel, height 400px, page indicators at bottom, pinch-to-zoom enabled
key_components.interaction: Swipe left/right to view multiple product images, tap to view fullscreen

key_components.name: Flower Name and Price
key_components.styling: Bold flower name (24px), price in primary color (20px bold), aligned left, white card background with rounded top corners (24px), padding 20px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display

key_components.name: Favorite Button
key_components.styling: Heart icon button, positioned top-right of name card, 48px circle, white background, shadow, toggles between outline and filled
key_components.interaction: Tapping toggles favorite status and saves to user favorites

key_components.name: Stock Availability Badge
key_components.styling: Small pill badge showing 'In Stock' in success color or 'Low Stock' in warning color, rounded corners (16px), padding 8px 16px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive status indicator

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'About this flower' header (16px bold), followed by description text (14px), padding 20px, margin 12px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Expandable text with 'Read More' if content exceeds 3 lines

key_components.name: Quantity Selector
key_components.styling: Horizontal layout with minus button, quantity number (large, centered), plus button, light gray background, rounded corners (12px), height 48px, width 140px
key_components.interaction: Plus/minus buttons increment/decrement quantity, minimum 1

key_components.name: Delivery Date Selector
key_components.styling: White card with calendar icon, 'Select Delivery Date' label, selected date displayed, right arrow, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens date picker modal with available delivery dates

key_components.name: Add to Cart Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button, white text 'Add to Cart - $XX.XX', height 56px, rounded corners (12px), fixed at bottom with padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Tapping adds item to cart with selected quantity and shows success toast, then navigates to cart screen

key_components.name: Related Flowers Section
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list titled 'You May Also Like', each card 140px wide with image, name, and price, spacing 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping a card navigates to that flower's detail screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from home screen, category listings, or search results. Users view details, select quantity and delivery date, then add to cart. Can navigate back or to related products.

screens.name: Shopping Cart Screen
screens.purpose: Display all items added to cart with ability to modify quantities, remove items, and proceed to checkout

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, 'My Cart' title centered (18px bold), trash icon on right for clear cart, height 56px, shadow
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, trash icon shows confirmation dialog to clear entire cart

key_components.name: Cart Items List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of cart item cards, each card has product image (80px square), name, price, quantity selector, and remove icon, white background, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Quantity selector updates item count, remove icon deletes item with confirmation, tapping card navigates to product detail

key_components.name: Empty Cart State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with 'Your cart is empty' message (18px), 'Start Shopping' button below, displayed when cart has no items
key_components.interaction: Start Shopping button navigates to home screen

key_components.name: Promo Code Input
key_components.styling: White card with input field 'Enter promo code', 'Apply' button on right, light border, rounded corners (12px), padding 16px, margin 12px horizontal
key_components.interaction: User types code and taps Apply to validate and apply discount

key_components.name: Order Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Order Summary' header, line items for Subtotal, Delivery Fee, Discount (if applied), and Total in bold, padding 20px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive summary display

key_components.name: Delivery Instructions Input
key_components.styling: White card with multiline text input, placeholder 'Add delivery instructions (optional)', light border, rounded corners (12px), height 80px, padding 16px
key_components.interaction: User can type special delivery notes

key_components.name: Saved Addresses Selector
key_components.styling: White card showing selected delivery address with edit icon, or 'Add Delivery Address' if none selected, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens address selection modal or address entry form

key_components.name: Proceed to Checkout Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button, white text 'Proceed to Checkout', height 56px, rounded corners (12px), fixed at bottom with padding 16px, shadow
key_components.interaction: Tapping validates cart and address, then navigates to checkout screen

key_components.name: Continue Shopping Link
key_components.styling: Text link 'Continue Shopping' in secondary color, centered above checkout button, 14px font
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates back to home screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom navigation or after adding items to cart. Users review items, modify quantities, add promo codes, select delivery address, then proceed to checkout or continue shopping.

screens.name: Checkout Screen
screens.purpose: Finalize order with delivery details, payment information, and order confirmation

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, 'Checkout' title centered (18px bold), height 56px, shadow
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to cart screen

key_components.name: Progress Indicator
key_components.styling: Horizontal stepper showing 'Delivery → Payment → Confirmation', current step highlighted in primary color, padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual progress indicator

key_components.name: Delivery Details Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Delivery Details' header, displays selected address, delivery date, and time slot, edit icon on right, padding 20px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping edit icon allows modification of delivery details

key_components.name: Contact Information Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Contact Information' header, displays phone number and email, edit icon on right, padding 20px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping edit icon opens contact editing form

key_components.name: Payment Method Selector
key_components.styling: White card with 'Payment Method' header, radio buttons for Credit Card, Debit Card, Digital Wallet options, selected option highlighted, padding 20px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Tapping an option selects that payment method

key_components.name: Card Details Input
key_components.styling: White card with input fields for card number, expiry date, CVV, and cardholder name, light borders, rounded corners (8px), padding 16px, margin 12px
key_components.interaction: User enters payment card information, fields validate format in real-time

key_components.name: Order Summary Expandable
key_components.styling: Collapsible card showing 'Order Summary' with total amount visible, tap to expand for full breakdown, light background, rounded corners (12px), padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Tapping toggles expansion to show itemized order details

key_components.name: Terms Checkbox
key_components.styling: Checkbox with label 'I agree to Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy', links underlined, padding 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: User must check to enable place order button, tapping links opens respective documents

key_components.name: Place Order Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button, white text 'Place Order - $XX.XX', height 56px, rounded corners (12px), fixed at bottom with padding 16px, disabled state if terms not accepted
key_components.interaction: Tapping processes payment and creates order, shows loading state, then navigates to confirmation screen

key_components.name: Security Badge
key_components.styling: Small centered text with lock icon 'Secure Payment', gray color, 12px font, above place order button
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive trust indicator

screens.user_flow: Accessed from cart screen after proceeding to checkout. Users review delivery details, enter payment information, accept terms, and place order. Success leads to confirmation screen, failure shows error message.

screens.name: Order Tracking Screen

key_components.name: Top Header Bar

key_components.name: Order Number Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Order #' and order number in bold (16px), order date below in gray, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px

key_components.name: Estimated Delivery Card
key_components.styling: Highlighted card with accent background, 'Estimated Delivery' label, date and time in large bold text (20px), padding 20px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px

key_components.name: Delivery Address Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Delivery Address' header, full address displayed, map icon on right, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping map icon opens map view with delivery location

key_components.name: Order Items List
key_components.styling: White card with 'Order Items' header, list of items with small product images (60px), names, quantities, and prices, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Tapping an item navigates to product detail screen

key_components.name: Contact Delivery Driver Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with phone icon, 'Contact Driver' text, light border, rounded corners (12px), height 48px, margin 12px horizontal, visible only when out for delivery
key_components.interaction: Tapping initiates call or message to delivery driver

key_components.name: Order Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Payment Summary' header, line items for subtotal, delivery, discount, and total, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive summary display

key_components.name: Need Help Button
key_components.styling: Outlined button with 'Need Help?' text, secondary color border, rounded corners (12px), height 48px, margin 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens customer support chat or contact options

key_components.name: Cancel Order Button

screens.user_flow: Accessed from orders list in bottom navigation or after order placement. Users track delivery progress, view order details, contact driver if needed, or request help. Can navigate back to orders list.

key_components.name: Saved Addresses Card

key_components.interaction: Tapping edit icon opens address management, Add New opens address entry form

key_components.name: Payment Methods Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Payment Methods' header, shows saved cards with masked numbers, edit icon, 'Add New Card' button, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping edit icon opens payment management, Add New opens card entry form

key_components.name: Favorites Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'My Favorites' header and count badge, horizontal scroll of favorite flower thumbnails (80px), padding 16px, rounded corners (12px)
key_components.interaction: Tapping a thumbnail navigates to that flower's detail screen

key_components.name: Notifications Toggle
key_components.styling: White card with 'Notifications' label and toggle switch on right, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Toggle switch enables/disables push notifications

key_components.name: Help & Support Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Help & Support' text and right arrow, padding 16px, rounded corners (12px), margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to help center or support chat

key_components.name: Logout Button
key_components.styling: Outlined button with error color border, 'Logout' text in error color, rounded corners (12px), height 48px, margin 16px horizontal
key_components.interaction: Tapping shows confirmation dialog, then logs user out and returns to login screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom navigation. Users view and edit profile information, manage addresses and payment methods, view order history, access favorites, adjust settings, or logout. Each section navigates to detailed management screens.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: White background, primary color border (2px), primary color text, rounded corners 12px, height 48px, medium font weight
ui_components.interaction: Tappable, shows pressed state with light primary color background

ui_components.name: Product Card
ui_components.styling: White background, rounded corners 12px, subtle shadow, contains product image (square, fills width), product name (16px), price (16px bold, primary color), favorite heart icon top-right, padding 12px
ui_components.interaction: Tappable card navigates to product detail, heart icon toggles favorite status independently

ui_components.name: Text Input Field
ui_components.styling: Light gray background #F0F0F0, rounded corners 8px, height 48px, padding 16px horizontal, placeholder text in gray, active state shows primary color border

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, height 64px, 5 evenly spaced icons with labels below (12px), active icon in primary color, inactive in gray, subtle top border

ui_components.name: Status Badge
ui_components.styling: Small pill-shaped badge, rounded corners 16px, padding 6px 12px, background color varies by status (success green, warning orange, error red, info blue), white text (12px)

responsive_design: The design follows a mobile-first approach optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets are minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Components scale proportionally on larger screens. Horizontal scrolling lists adapt to show more items on tablets. Bottom navigation remains fixed on mobile, may convert to side navigation on tablets. Images use responsive sizing with aspect ratio preservation. Text scales using relative units to maintain readability across devices.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. All images include descriptive alt text. Form inputs have associated labels and error messages. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported for all interactive elements. Focus indicators visible on all focusable elements. Error states clearly communicated with color, icons, and text. Font sizes minimum 16px for body text to prevent zoom on mobile.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (left/right for navigation, up for modals). Button presses show 100ms scale-down effect. Loading states use smooth spinner rotation. Toast notifications slide in from top with 200ms ease-out. Card taps show subtle shadow increase. Heart icon favorite toggle animates with scale and color change. Quantity selectors animate number changes. Scroll-triggered animations for list items appearing. All animations respect user's reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for inactive states and filled style for active states. Icons are 24x24px standard size, scaled to 20px for compact contexts. Icon set includes: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). Icons use currentColor to inherit text color for easy theming. All icons have 2px stroke weight for visual consistency.
